message: So, I’ve been there—sitting in the dark, wondering if I should light a candle or just go to bed at 7 PM. Turns out, being unprepared for a blackout can be a bit of a comedy show! I found this handy resource that lays out some simple tips to keep your cool when the lights go out. It’s all about having a plan, so you don't end up using your phone flashlight to search for snacks in the dark. What’s your go-to strategy for surviving a power outage?
